title: Happy Baby in Striped Romper Outdoors, 1928 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful 1920s outdoor snapshot capturing a cheerful baby sitting barefoot on gravel or garden ground. The infant wears a striped, collared one-piece playsuit or romper and clutches a small patterned toy ball while smiling upward into the warm sunlight. In the background, lush garden foliage and a rustic wooden bench or arbor are illuminated by dappled light. The reverse side features pencil scribbles, adhesive remnants from having been pasted into an album, and a circular developer's stamp dated August 1928.
